Definition: a drop; specifically, an aromatic gum (probably stacte)
BiblicalUsage: Stacte is one of the sweet spices beaten into the holy incense before the LORD, and the clouds distil their small drops of water upon the earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the small drop has its place in God's worship: the gum in the incense and the rain on the ground are both His provision, and nothing He gives is too small to matter.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
